Package neqsim.process.safety.selfheating

Class BasketTestPoint

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.selfheating.BasketTestPoint
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BasketTestPoint extends Object implements Serializable
A single hot-storage ("basket") test observation: one sample size taken to its critical oven temperature.

In a standard basket test (EN 15188, ASTM E2021) a sample of the material is held in a wire-mesh basket of known size inside an oven, and the oven temperature is bracketed to find the lowest temperature at which the sample runs away rather than settling to a steady temperature. Repeating this for several basket sizes yields the data set that BasketTestRegression converts into Arrhenius parameters.

  • Constructor Details

    • BasketTestPoint

      public BasketTestPoint(SelfHeatingGeometry geometry, double characteristicDimension, String dimensionUnit, double criticalTemperature, String temperatureUnit)
      Construct a basket-test observation.
      Parameters:
      geometry - basket shape; must not be null
      characteristicDimension - characteristic half-dimension of the basket, matching the convention of SelfHeatingGeometry.getDimensionDescription(); must be positive
      dimensionUnit - length unit of the dimension ("m", "cm", "mm" or "in")
      criticalTemperature - lowest oven temperature at which the sample ran away
      temperatureUnit - temperature unit ("K" or "C")
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the geometry is null, the dimension is not positive, a unit is unsupported, or the critical temperature is not positive
